get.description: Retrieve all merchant data including basic info, menus, services, and items

lastUpdate.description: Last modified date and time in ISO timestamp format

TTL.description: Time to Live in seconds (min: 500, max: 86400)

state.description: State or country subdivision. It is recommended (but not required) that you use the ISO 3166-2 representation

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees. Values are restricted to the range [-90, 90]

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees. Values are restricted to the range [-180, 180]

logoImage.description: Image to be used as the merchant logo

bannerImage.description: Image to be used as the merchant banner (the banner display depends on the client application interface)

createdAt.description: Merchant creation date and time in ISO timestamp format

acceptedCards.description: Card brands accepted by the merchant

status.description: Indicates if the service is Available or Unavailable. Only use this when you must disable the service due to an unexpected event and you don't know when it will be re-established (e.g. do not use for holidays)

serviceType.description: The type of service: DELIVERY (delivered to customer address), TAKEOUT (picked up at establishment), INDOOR (consumed inside establishment)

timing.description: Timings that the service accepts: INSTANT (orders prepared immediately), SCHEDULED (orders scheduled for specific date/time), ONDEMAND (orders delivered when consumer indicates ready to pick up). Defaults to INSTANT if not informed

scheduleTimeWindow.description: Time window where scheduling will be possible. Example: If 15_MINUTES is chosen, then the available scheduling times will be displayed every 15 minutes (e.g. 9:15, 9:30, 9:45, 10:00)

scheduleStartWindow.description: How long after the merchant has opened (considering the serviceHours entity) the first schedule time will be displayed. Example: Service starts at 9:00 and the option 45_MINUTES was entered, then the first available time for scheduling will be 9:45

scheduleEndWindow.description: How long before the merchant closes (considering the serviceHours entity) the last schedule time will be displayed. Example: Service ends at 23:00 and the option 60_MINUTES was entered, then the last available time for scheduling will be 22:00

schedule.description: Information regarding the time windows for scheduling. Only applies to SCHEDULED service timing

serviceTiming.description: Information regarding the accepted service times

servicePriority.description: Indicates whether the merchant works with different order preparation and delivery priorities. Must enter up to how many priority levels the merchant serves

menuId.description: The id value of the Menu entity correlated to this Service entity

targetAppId.description: For situations where the merchant needs to send different menus for the same serviceType to different Ordering Applications. Must be filled in with the AppId of the Ordering Application which will receive this service info

id.description: Unique identifier of the service area

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate of the polygon point. Values are restricted to the range [-90, 90]

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate of the polygon point. Values are restricted to the range [-180, 180]

geoCoordinates.description: Coordinates of each point of the polygon. Points must be specified in a counter-clockwise direction

value.description: Price value. 4 decimal places are accepted

currency.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code

price.description: Price of the fee for this polygon

estimateDeliveryTime.description: Estimate delivery time for this polygon in minutes

polygon.description: Polygon or multipolygon expressed as a series of three or more space delimited points. If polygon is chosen, geoRadius is not required

geoMidpointLatitude.description: Latitude coordinate at the center of the CIRCLE area. Values are restricted to the range [-90, 90]

geoMidpointLongitude.description: Longitude coordinate at the center of the CIRCLE area. Values are restricted to the range [-180, 180]

size.description: Size of the CIRCLE radius in meters

value.description: Price value. 4 decimal places are accepted

currency.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code

price.description: Price of the fee for this CIRCLE size

estimateDeliveryTime.description: Estimate delivery time for this CIRCLE size in minutes

radius.description: Information about each radius of the CIRCLE that the merchant serves

geoRadius.description: Approximate radius (in meters) of the CIRCLE area. If geoRadius is chosen, polygon is not required

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate of the polygon point. Values are restricted to the range [-90, 90]

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate of the polygon point. Values are restricted to the range [-180, 180]

geoCoordinates.description: Coordinates of each point of the exclusion polygon. Points must be specified in a counter-clockwise direction

exclusionAreaPolygon.description: Specific polygons within the previously mapped delivery area where NO deliveries will be made. Can be filled in regardless of whether polygon or geoRadius is used

serviceArea.description: Required if serviceType is set to DELIVERY. Describes the geographical region in which food can be delivered

id.description: Unique identifier of the service hours

dayOfWeek.description: Day of the week for which these service hours are valid

startTime.description: Specific time of day in ISO format starting from which users' orders can be placed

endTime.description: Specific time of day in ISO format beyond which users' orders cannot be placed

timePeriods.description: Time window from which users' orders can be placed

weekHours.description: List of the day(s) of the week and time periods for which the service is valid

startTime.description: Specific time of day in ISO format starting from which users' orders can be placed

endTime.description: Specific time of day in ISO format beyond which users' orders cannot be placed

holidayHours.description: Map of holiday dates, each with optional timePeriods. If a date does not have a time period specified, the restaurant will be closed for that date

serviceHours.description: The time window which users can place orders

id.description: A unique identifier of the menu

externalCode.description: Menu external code (typically the merchant Software Service menu code)

categoryId.description: IDs of child Category entities corresponding to this Menu. Default assumes all Category entities are available in this menu

id.description: A unique identifier of the category

availabilityId.description: IDs of Availability entities. If not informed, assumes AVAILABLE at all times

itemOfferId.description: IDs of child ItemOffer entities corresponding to this Category

id.description: A unique identifier of the item offer

itemId.description: The id of the Item entity correlated to this ItemOffer

value.description: The actual price value. 4 decimal places are accepted

originalValue.description: The original price value. 4 decimal places are accepted

currency.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code

price.description: Price of the menu item offer

availabilityId.description: IDs of Availability entities. If not informed, assumes AVAILABLE at all times

optionGroupsId.description: IDs of OptionGroup entities corresponding to this ItemOffer

id.description: A unique identifier of the item

image.description: Item image. Ignored if the images array contains any value

CRC-32.description: CRC-32 of the image file for change detection

type.description: MAIN for larger images (item detail), THUMB for smaller images (menu listing)

images.description: Array of item images with size variations. Takes precedence over the image field

description.description: Nutrition information in free text (e.g. "Contains preservatives")

calories.description: Number of calories in Cal, kcal, or kJ (e.g. "2000 Cal")

suitableDiet.description: Dietary restrictions the item complies with

isAlcoholic.description: Indicates if an item is alcoholic

serving.description: Number of people the portion serves

unit.description: Unit of measurement (UN, KG, L, OZ, LB, GAL)

id.description: A unique identifier of the option group

minPermitted.description: Minimum number of options that must be selected

maxPermitted.description: Maximum number of options that can be selected

priceMethod.description: How the option group price is calculated: SUM (added), MAX (highest between MAX groups), AVG (average between AVG groups). Default is SUM

id.description: A unique identifier of the option

itemId.description: The id of the Item entity correlated to this Option

value.description: The actual price value. 4 decimal places are accepted

originalValue.description: The original price value. 4 decimal places are accepted

currency.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code

maxPermitted.description: Maximum quantity of this option which can be selected in the group

id.description: A unique identifier of the availability

startDate.description: Availability start date (e.g. "2021-05-27"). If not informed, availability starts immediately

endDate.description: Availability end date (e.g. "2021-05-30"). If not informed, availability has no expiration

dayOfWeek.description: Day of the week for which these service hours are valid

startTime.description: Specific time of day in ISO format starting from which users' orders can be placed

endTime.description: Specific time of day in ISO format beyond which users' orders cannot be placed

timePeriods.description: Time window from which users' orders can be placed
